rules.statement: The yearly statutory leave entitlement shall be at least 4 times the employee's contractual weekly working time (entitledHours >= 4 x contractHoursPerWeek).
Recorded leave taken shall not exceed the total leave entitlement for the year (usedHours <= entitledHours + bovenwettelijkHours) — approved leave may never push a balance negative.
Statutory leave hours of a year shall lapse on 1 July of the following year; a balance carrying statutory hours records expiryDate = <year+1>-07-01.

rules.source: Regeling procesgang eerste en tweede ziektejaar art. 2 en 4; ZW art. 38 (42-wekenmelding, https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0002598)
rules.statement: The WVP milestone Due dates shall equal firstSickDay plus 6/8/42/52 weeks (probleemanalyse / plan van aanpak / UWV 42-wekenmelding / eerstejaarsevaluatie); on an open (gemeld) case none of the four Due dates may be null.

rules.source: Regeling procesgang eerste en tweede ziektejaar art. 2 en 4; ZW art. 38
rules.statement: An open (gemeld) case with a milestone Due date in the past and no matching Done date is a violation (mandatory); a Due date within 14 days and not yet Done is flagged as advisory, to be surfaced by occ hrmq:rules:audit.
During sickness the employer shall continue at least 70% of wages for the first 104 weeks; an open (gemeld) case shall carry loondoorbetalingPercentage >= 70.
